WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
GROUP BY i.symbol_id, s.file_id, f.is_test
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id

SELECT c.callee_name, COUNT(*) AS call_sites
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE c.resolution = 'unresolved' AND NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY c.callee_name
ORDER BY call_sites DESC, c.callee_name
LIMIT 50

SELECT i.imported_file_id AS file_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.file_id) AS importers
FROM code.imports i
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.imported_file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test AND i.file_id <> i.imported_file_id
GROUP BY i.imported_file_id
ORDER BY importers DESC, file_id
LIMIT 50

SELECT v.symbol_id, v.kind, v.inbound_calls, v.callback_references, v.distinct_callers
FROM code.inbound_call_counts v
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = v.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test AND v.inbound_calls > 0
ORDER BY v.inbound_calls DESC, v.symbol_id
LIMIT 50
